record.question: Which metal is not found in the Harappan civilization?
record.explanation: Answer D: Iron. Harappan material culture used copper/bronze, gold, silver and other metals; iron was not part of the mature Harappan toolkit. Reference: https://asi.nic.in/harappan-civilization/. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical context: General Studies Paper-II, January 2026 examination; current affairs are interpreted as of the paper date.. Officeholders, survey results and forecasts refer to that original paper, not necessarily the present. No matching examiner key is asserted.
